name: Bird Observation Corpus
inspiredBy: Community bird observations (eBird-style) · India-primary with global decontamination slice
whyChosen: Community bird checklists pair free-text field notes with species, place, and time — the richest textual signal for Ataavi. India-primary coverage matches our launch geography; a thin global slice supports benchmark decontamination without diluting regional language mix.
